Name: FarmSwing
Author: YourPeachiness
Description:
[heading] Description [/heading]

[quote]Set up a little swing on your farm and let your fluffy companions share every golden evening with you.
This mod adds a swing you can actually sit on. Have Robin build one for 5,000g (ready the same day), sit down, and tap along with the sway to pump it up. Once it's going, it settles into a gentle, steady rhythm — it won't swing higher and higher, so you can just sit there and do nothing at all.
Turtles, cats and dogs wander over on their own, hop up and sit beside you. Sometimes a butterfly drifts in and lands on your head, or rests on the roses woven into the ropes, flutters a few times, and drifts away again.
The breeze, the sunset, and their quiet company will fill the whole evening.
Go sit down — they've been waiting for you.[/quote][line]
[heading]Main features [/heading]
[list]
[*][b]A swing that really swings[/b] — sit down and tap W / S along with the sway (both keys are configurable) to pump it up. Once it's going it keeps a calm, steady pace: no runaway speed, no being flung off.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Your pets come to you[/b] — turtles, cats and dogs wander over, hop on and sit beside you. Two seats, so up to two companions at a time. Sit down and the nearest one will come over on its own.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Butterfly cameo[/b] — now and then a butterfly drifts in and perches on your head, or on the roses along the ropes, for a little while.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]A letter from Robin[/b] — the morning after you install the mod, a few words from Robin are waiting in your mailbox. It only comes once.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Plushies can sit too[/b] — hold any item and right-click the swing to set it on the seat (two at most, one per side). Left-click empty-handed to take it back.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Yours to tune[/b] — with Generic Mod Config Menu installed you can rebind the pumping keys and set how many pets may share one swing (0 = none).[/*]
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Made for company[/b] — perfect for idling, taking cosy screenshots, or just sitting still for a while after a long day.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Installation instructions [/heading]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (see Requirements below);[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Download this mod. [b]No need to unzip[/b] — dropping the archive straight into your Mods folder works just as well as extracting it, whichever you prefer;[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Place it in the
[code]Mods[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley installation directory;[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI — if you see
[code]Farm Swing[/code]in the startup log, you're all set;[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]In game, visit [b]Robin's Carpenter Shop[/b] and build the swing for 5,000g. It's finished the same day (no materials needed).[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Requirements [/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b] or newer;[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0[/b] or newer;[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]No[/b] Content Patcher and no other dependencies required;[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Optional: with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] you can rebind keys and change the pet limit in game (everything works fine without it).[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Good to know [/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Before uninstalling, please demolish any swings you've built[/b] (ask Robin). The swing is a custom building; once the mod is gone the game can no longer read its data and your save may fail to load. This is how custom buildings work in Stardew Valley 1.6 in general, not a flaw of this mod — after demolishing them you can uninstall safely at any time, and anything left on the seat is returned to you.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Nothing on the seat is lost[/b] when a swing is demolished — items go back into your inventory, or drop at your feet if it's full.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Single-player focused for now.[/b] In multiplayer, other players can see the swing and whoever is sitting on it, but it won't sway for them. It won't corrupt saves or throw errors; proper multiplayer sync may come in a future version.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*] Whether pets hop on is up to chance (you can also tweak it in
[code]config.json[/code]). Set "max pets per swing" to 0 if you'd rather sit alone.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
[list]
[*]Special thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI, and to the whole Stardew Valley modding community — this gentle community is what let a small idea take root;[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Thanks to ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley, a world full of kindness;[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]And thanks to every friend who encouraged me and tested it with me, over and over;[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Last but not least — thank you for downloading. I hope it brings you some comfort too.[/*]
[/list]
